d: Short, mint-green hair with blunt bangs and a sleek texture frames a youthful, mature face with sharp, narrow red eyes. The slender build is dressed in a white off-shoulder blouse under a purple corset, paired with a short purple skirt, black thigh-high stockings, and a long, flowing purple cape. A wide-brimmed purple witch hat adorned with black feathers sits atop the head, while accessories include black fingerless gloves, a brown utility belt with hanging potion vials, and a wooden broomstick with a skull ornament.
